root_cause: The always-visible matching code path does not correctly filter out freelancers whose GitHub token_valid flag is false. In Run 1 (no Postgres) this defect was masked by a different bug (DEFECT-002a below) that made the suite hang instead of skip; with real infra it surfaces as a genuine functional/access-control defect.
recommended_fix_not_applied: Fix the always-visible freelancer query/filter in the api-gateway matching route to exclude rows where the freelancer's GitHub connection is stale (token_valid=false), consistent with the other 3 tests in the same describe block that already pass (e.g. correctly including freelancers with no profile row, correctly marking unmeasured skill matches).

reproduction_steps: Run `npm test` in apps/api-gateway with no Postgres reachable on DATABASE_URL (Run 1, before infra was brought up).
expected_behavior: The file's own `PG_UP` check (`if (!PG_UP) announceSkip(...)`) should cause the suite to skip cleanly and immediately when Postgres is unreachable.
actual_behavior: In Run 1 (no infra), all 4 tests in this describe block hung and failed with `Test timed out in 5000ms` instead of skipping — masking DEFECT-002 above until Phase 5 brought real Postgres online and let the suite actually execute.
root_cause: PG_UP detection did not short-circuit this describe block before it attempted live database operations when no DB was reachable.
recommended_fix_not_applied: Apply the same `describe.skipIf(!PG_UP)` pattern used elsewhere in the codebase consistently to this describe block, or make PG_UP detection synchronous/awaited before any test body runs. NOTE: this is a test-harness issue separate from, and masking, DEFECT-002's real functional bug — fixing only this would not fix DEFECT-002.

expected_behavior: A `test` script that exits 0 (either because tests exist and pass, or the workspace intentionally declares no test script).
actual_behavior: `vitest run` exits 1 with 'No test files found' — the workspace defines a `test` script (`vitest run`) but has zero files matching vitest's test include glob anywhere under the package.
root_cause: No test files were ever authored for this package, but the generic workspace `test` script template was still wired in, so `npm test --workspaces --if-present` treats this as a real failure rather than a no-op.
